resume: Reimplementation of Baud Girl's FM-1+VA, written from its manual: three engines (six-operator FM with 32 algorithms, Virtual Analog, 8-Bit), seven effects, a 16-pattern sequencer and 128 original presets.

commandes.role: Down one octave; with OCT+ at the same time, back to octave 0.
Up one octave; with OCT- at the same time, back to octave 0.
Opens the effects list; SEL enters, HOME goes back.

Enters the selected item of a list. Held with ALGORITHM, advances by ten; held with SELECT in the Effects list, moves an effect; held while the sequencer plays, keeps the note on its step; held with PRESETS, picks the pattern.
Opens the envelope list; held for one second, turns the envelope on or off.
Opens the global settings (MIDI, count-in, local control, keyboard bend, theme).
Goes back. On the home screen, opens the wheel banks; held with SELECT, changes bank; held with a wheel, changes what it plays.
Keeps the preset, the settings and the 16 patterns in this browser.
Starts and stops the sequencer; held, turns it on or off.
Records step by step, or in real time during playback.
Moves the selection; in the sequencer, moves the diamond.
Changes preset. Without SAVE, returns to the saved version.
Changes the FM algorithm, or the selected value.

gestes: HOME held + SELECT: changes wheel bank.
SEL held + ALGORITHM: advances by ten.
SEL held + SELECT: moves an effect in the Effects list.
ENV held for one second: turns the envelope on or off.

modes.texte: Presets 001-064 are FM, 065-080 and 113-128 Virtual Analog, 081-112 8-Bit. On an 8-Bit preset, the drums are three octaves lower (OCT- three times).

PLAY starts and stops; held, it turns the sequencer on or off. REC records step by step, or in real time during playback. SELECT moves the diamond; SEL held while playing keeps the note on its step. SEQ opens the pattern settings, SEL held + PRESETS picks the pattern.

The Import a DX7 sound button, below the FM-1, loads a Yamaha DX7 .syx file. A single patch replaces the displayed preset without saving it (SAVE keeps it). A bank of 32 patches first asks a question on screen: ALGORITHM picks which of the four preset banks to replace. You can also drop the file on the FM-1 or send it as SysEx from MIDI software (section 11.5 of the manual).

a_savoir: Bluetooth (BT Mode, BT Peripherals) is missing: the browser goes through the system MIDI ports, Bluetooth included if it has paired it.
The factory presets and Baud Girl's packs are not public: the 128 presets here are original.
